description.p: Roots of stone and packed earth erupt upward around one creature you can see within range, standing on the ground. The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, its flying speed becomes 0 and it has the Restrained condition for the duration; the roots also anchor it in place, preventing teleportation that would move it more than 5 feet from where it started. On a successful save, the target's flying speed is halved until the end of its next turn instead.
A Restrained target, or a creature within reach of it, can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. On a success, the roots crumble and the spell ends.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

setters.set: strength, save, restrained, flying, upcasting, higher-level spell slot
